review.tagline: Self-hosted multi-provider chat UI with agents, MCP tools and multi-user auth
review.summary: LibreChat is a ChatGPT-style web interface that connects to Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure, Google, AWS Bedrock, Ollama and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. It adds multi-user login (OAuth2, LDAP, email), conversation search and branching, no-code agents with MCP tools, a sandboxed code interpreter, artifacts and web search. An admin panel manages users, roles and settings.
review.audience: Teams and self-hosters wanting one shared chat UI across many model providers
strengths: Many providers in one UI, plus custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints without a proxy
Multi-user auth via OAuth2, LDAP and email, with admin panel and token spend tools
Agents with MCP servers, Skills, subagents, file search and code execution
Resumable streams and Redis support for horizontally scaled deployments
weaknesses: Large feature surface; the README lists many components to configure and operate
Some features, such as attached code workspaces, are marked highly experimental
Code interpreter relies on a separate ClickHouse/code-interpreter service
README gives no RAM or hardware requirements and no default port
needs: Needs Docker Compose (optional), Redis (for scaled deployments), ClickHouse/code-interpreter (for code execution), LibreChat RAG API (for file chat)
Models: Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Google, Vertex AI
